name: library_search
description: Search the school library catalogue by title or author. Use this to find books before getting details or placing a hold. Returns matching books with their ids. Changes nothing.

query.description: Words to look for, such as part of a title or an author's name.

field.description: Which field to search: title or author.

name: library_get_book
description: Get one book's details by its id. Use this after a search, when the student wants to know more about one book. Returns the title, author and whether it is on the shelf. Changes nothing.

book_id.description: The book's id, such as bk_1234.

name: library_place_hold
description: Place a hold on a book for a student. Use this only when the student asks to reserve a book. Adds a hold record and returns its confirmation.

book_id.description: The id of the book to hold.

student_id.description: The student's id, such as st_5678.
